steps.name: preflight-and-prettier
steps.command: git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx src/styles/pinned-media.css src/styles/map.css e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx src/styles/pinned-media.css src/styles/map.css e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts

steps.name: static-and-unit-build
steps.command: cd frontend && npm run lint && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/components/map/pinned-media/pinnedMediaDrawerStage.test.ts && npm run build

steps.name: chrome-gesture-and-drawer-regression
steps.command: cd frontend && E2E_CHROME_EXECUTABLE='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' ../scripts/quality/e2e.sh e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts e2e/visual/pinned-media-drawer.spec.ts --workers=1

steps.name: publish-format-only-if-needed
steps.command: git add frontend/src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx frontend/src/styles/pinned-media.css frontend/src/styles/map.css frontend/e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts && git diff --cached --check && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'style(drawer): format verified transition and fit changes') && git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix/drawer-transition-content-fit-20261109 && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD
